note: Family-run since 1970, wooded, with an on-site lake plus Kalamazoo River access and canoe/kayak rentals. Directory listings (not the operator) describe ~125 sites with electric and water, a few pull-throughs, a tent area, open about Apr 15 - Oct 1. No website of its own; Facebook page and Google listing only. --Claude
